description: Search ~440,000 active US hospital/healthcare jobs (staff and permanent roles). Returns up to 20 matches with title, employer, city and state, the pay when the posting lists it, the state license a licensed role needs, and a link to the job page. Jobs with verified-working apply links rank first.

query.description: Keywords: role, title, employer, or city (e.g. "ICU nurse", "pharmacist", "CHRISTUS")

state.description: Two-letter US state code, e.g. TX

name: search_jobs
title: Search hospital jobs
